title: 先把把手往上提  (Lift the Handle)

segments.t: Qing arrives early for her very first morning at the Courtyard Inn in Chengdu. Behind the front desk, veteran handyman Chen is already pouring strong hot tea. Listen to the conversation in Mandarin first without worrying about catching every word.
早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
纸本子？真的吗？
下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
'Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?'
早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
'Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.'
啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
'Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.'
我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
'I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.'
第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
'On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?'
在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
'In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.'
纸本子？真的吗？
'A paper notebook? Really?'
下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
'When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.'
有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
'Fair enough! Are these the keys?'
对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
'Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.'
太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
'Great. Please tell me what I need to know.'
第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
'Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
纸本子？真的吗？

对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。

Qing is inside, the eight brass keys are on the board, and her first morning has begun. Don't worry if a few words went past quickly; they come back all week. See you next time.
再见！
